## Override cheat-sheet

1. **Code** — `bind_instance(container, Interface, my_impl)` always wins.
2. **Env dotted** — `VARCO_<SEAM>_BACKEND=pkg.mod:Name`.
3. **Env named** — `VARCO_<SEAM>_BACKEND=<value>`.
